'''Esshai''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Holding the role of "Transporter," Esshai was one of those responsible for overseeing departures from the [[Mercantile Plaza]] on Manaan. Imperial-allied individuals could not travel below the surface without Esshai's authorization.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Esshai appears as the Imperial courier for the Tactical Flashpoint "Depths of Manaan," which was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.9: Galactic Strongholds Early Access.<ref name="TOR" />
